tasks.title: Man the Defenses
tasks.description: Help defend Oceangreen by defeating the foe identified by Sergeant Bronal Cadran in Oceangreen Hills. Return to the sergeant when the threat has been dealt with.

tasks.title: No Cure for Death
tasks.description: Strike against the plague cult in Oceangreen Village. Defeat fifteen cultists, then return to Sergeant Bronal Cadran in Oceangreen Hills and report your success.

tasks.title: Familiarity is Key
tasks.description: Scout the ten marked landmarks in Oceangreen Village, including the ruins, pits, village square, inn, smithy and surrounding buildings. Return to Captain Hiran Tillin in Oceangreen Hills when your survey is complete.

tasks.title: Stop the Contamination
tasks.description: Speak with Acolyte Koel to reach the village defense, then speak with Billik to begin. Protect the villagers, their leaders and their supplies from the attackers. After the village is safe, report to Captain Hiran Tillin in Oceangreen Hills.

tasks.title: A Dread Challenger
tasks.description: Speak with Acolyte Koel to return to the village defense and coordinate with Billik. Hold the village against the renewed assault and protect its residents and leaders. Report the outcome to Captain Hiran Tillin in Oceangreen Hills.

tasks.title: Beat the Blackburrow Boss
tasks.description: Enter Blackburrow with your companions and use two runestones to disable the ward. Force Clan Chief Vel`tix to surrender, obtain his key and defeat Gnarl Sawbones Brankt in the hidden chamber. Return both runestones and the key to Raxtor Darkpaw in Oceangreen Hills.

tasks.title: Summary Execution
tasks.description: Weaken the Blackburrow forces by defeating five of their elite gnolls and fifteen other assigned gnolls. Return to your Darkpaw contact in Oceangreen Hills when the hunt is complete.

tasks.title: What Evil Lurks in the Hearts of Gnolls?
tasks.description: Recover the stolen supplies from the gnolls lurking in Oceangreen Hills while this task is underway. Bring the recovered supplies back to the Darkpaw who requested your help.

tasks.title: Freedom!
tasks.description: Enter Blackburrow and recover the orders carried by Kegrak. Defeat the slavers guarding the eight captured pups, free the pups and overcome Grohlok. Return to Raxtor Darkpaw in Oceangreen Hills to report their rescue.

tasks.title: Invading the Invaders
tasks.description: Attack the occupying gnolls in Blackburrow. Defeat twenty assigned gnolls and collect four insignias, then deliver the insignias to your Darkpaw contact in Oceangreen Hills.
